_comment: Single source of truth for the 'What people say' section on index.html. Edit this file and run `npm run generate-testimonials` (or `npm run deploy:safe`, which runs it automatically) to regenerate the markup. Do not hand-edit the cards between the BEGIN:testimonials/END:testimonials markers in index.html, it will be overwritten.

_schema.quote: the testimonial text, without surrounding quotation marks (added by markup/CSS)
_schema.name: person's full name
_schema.title: person's title/role, shown under their name

testimonials.quote: Doug provided mentorship and empowerment, giving me the autonomy to learn web components, design systems, and even design itself, always keeping our focus on the user experience for our colleagues.
testimonials.name: Charlie Hogland
testimonials.title: Lead Principal UI Engineer, FM

testimonials.quote: Doug's efforts had a tremendous positive impact on my daily work as a Lead UX Designer, managing a design system component library in Figma that significantly improved the speed and efficiency of my UX deliverables.
testimonials.name: John Stammerman
testimonials.title: Design Systems Expert · Product Designer

testimonials.quote: Doug is the lynchpin between product design and engineering, always seeking to improve existing processes and find new technologies to supplement them.
testimonials.name: Nirvana Tikku
testimonials.title: Software Architect at Microsoft
